definition: Aggregated live usable storage across the 7 major BMC supply lakes (Bhatsa, Upper Vaitarna, Middle Vaitarna, Tansa, Modak Sagar, Tulsi, Vihar).
data_source: MCGM Water Supply Department Lake Level Reports
known_limitations: Storage levels reflect bulk availability, not instantaneous conveyance throughput.
double_counting_risk: High if added directly with rainfall without hydrological routing.
operational_relevance: Determines overall municipal allocation ceiling and seasonal rationing thresholds.

definition: Cumulative 24-hour precipitation measured at lake catchment rain gauge stations.
data_source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) / BMC Disaster Cell
known_limitations: Runoff lag varies from 6 to 36 hours based on soil saturation.
operational_relevance: Anticipates lake replenishment and overflow risks.

definition: Operational throughput limit of Bhandup Complex and Panjrapur Water Treatment Plants.
data_source: MCGM Bhandup Complex Hydraulic Engineering Records
known_limitations: Raw water turbidity above 100 NTU forces 15-30% backwash derating.
double_counting_risk: Low (acts as a physical bottleneck cap).
operational_relevance: Strict upper bound on potable water production regardless of lake abundance.

factor_name: Power Grid Outage at Pumping Stations
definition: Duration and power deficit at master balancing reservoirs and pumping stations (e.g., Ghatkopar, Powai).
data_source: Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Co. (MSETCL) / Adani Electricity Log
known_limitations: Diesel backup generators provide ~40% pumping capacity for up to 6 hours.
double_counting_risk: High if combined with pressure drop without causal modeling.
operational_relevance: Triggers rapid regional pressure drop and dry tap conditions.

definition: Estimated transmission and distribution leakage, illegal tappings, and meter inaccuracies.
data_source: MCGM Water Distribution Improvement Project / Castalia NRW Study
known_limitations: Difficult to disaggregate physical pipe bursts from unmetered standpost consumption.
double_counting_risk: Moderate with pipe age and burst history.
operational_relevance: Subtracts from raw piped water to calculate net delivered volume.

definition: Mandatory unallocated water cushion reserved for firefighting, hospital disasters, and mass contamination.
data_source: BMC Disaster Management Emergency Action Plan / Policy 3.0
known_limitations: Fixed buffer reduces available water during routine rationing.
operational_relevance: Guarantees critical facilities cannot be starved by aggregate demand.

definition: Number of roadworthy municipal and contracted water tankers currently available for dispatch.
data_source: BMC Transport & Solid Waste Management Logistics Registry
known_limitations: Driver absenteeism and maintenance downtime cause shift-to-shift variance.
operational_relevance: Limits total physical volumetric dispatch per hour.

definition: Official resident population enumerated in the 2011 Census of India across 24 administrative wards.
data_source: Census of India 2011 / MCGM Ward Profiles
known_limitations: Does not capture post-2011 suburban growth or daily floating worker population (est. 2-3M).
double_counting_risk: High if combined directly with household count and density.
operational_relevance: Foundational denominator for per-capita allocation and aggregate baseline demand.

definition: Percentage of ward residents residing in notified and non-notified slum settlements without individual metered tap connections.
data_source: MCGM Slum Sanitation Program & Development Plan 2034
known_limitations: Excludes newly formed non-notified settlements post-survey cutoff.
operational_relevance: Identifies communities lacking household underground/overhead storage.

definition: Government service benchmark for basic domestic water consumption: 135 Liters Per Capita per Day (LPCD).
data_source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) Service Level Benchmarks
known_limitations: Informal settlements typically receive 45-90 LPCD in practice due to network pressure gradients.
operational_relevance: Establishes the normative ceiling for minimum human right to water under Article 21.

definition: Cumulative consecutive days during which piped water pressure failed to meet the 0.5 bar minimum threshold.
data_source: MCGM SCADA Pressure Telemetry / Corroborated Citizen Outage Reports
known_limitations: Citizen reporting exhibits digital-divide reporting bias in illiterate areas.
double_counting_risk: High if combined directly with complaint volume without deduplication.
operational_relevance: Critical operational indicator of acute hydration stress and disease risk.

definition: Peak daily dry-bulb temperature recorded at Santacruz / Colaba IMD weather observatories.
data_source: IMD Mumbai Regional Meteorological Centre
known_limitations: Urban heat island effect creates up to 3.5°C localized microclimate variances in dense slums.
operational_relevance: Empirical driver of +8% to +22% seasonal hydration and cooling demand surges.

definition: Categorical indicator (Normal, Yellow, Orange, Red) based on departure from normal maximum temperature (>= 4.5°C departure).
data_source: IMD Heat Action Plan Alerts / BMC Disaster Management Cell
known_limitations: Triggers municipal emergency protocol rather than gradual continuous demand adjustments.
operational_relevance: Mandates priority water tankers to public shelters, labor camps, and hospitals.

definition: Non-negotiable daily volume required for government hospitals, dialysis centers, and fire services.
data_source: MCGM Public Health Department & Directorate of Health Services Maharashtra
known_limitations: Patient influx during epidemics can increase clinical water demand by up to 50%.
operational_relevance: Strict priority tier: 100% fulfillment guarantee under all feasible operating conditions.

definition: Age in years and material class (Cast Iron, Mild Steel, Ductile Iron) of municipal secondary water mains.
data_source: MCGM Hydraulic Engineer GIS Asset Database
known_limitations: Corrosion rates vary heavily depending on saline groundwater intrusion in coastal wards (e.g., A, B, C).
operational_relevance: Predicts structural failure and contamination risk during suction backflow.

definition: Indicator that a delivery cluster is situated at the hydraulic dead-end or high elevation of a distribution zone.
data_source: MCGM Water Distribution Master Plan / Hydraulic Flow Models
known_limitations: Pressure fluctuations depend on upstream valve throttling schedules.
double_counting_risk: Moderate with days since last supply.
operational_relevance: Explains chronic supply failure despite normal citywide reservoir levels.

definition: True road-network transit distance from designated water tanker filling depot to destination delivery coordinates.
data_source: OpenStreetMap (OSM) Mumbai Road Network / BMC Traffic Police
known_limitations: Slum internal alleys are unnavigable for 10,000L heavy tankers (requires 3,000L mini-tankers).
double_counting_risk: STRICT: Must NOT enter Human Need/Equity Priority formula.
operational_relevance: Determines transit fuel consumption, fleet cycle turnaround, and ETA.

definition: Estimated queuing and gantry filling delay at municipal filling depots (e.g., Mahim, Worli, Ghatkopar).
data_source: BMC Depot Operations Log / WaterFlow Logistics Engine
known_limitations: Queue spikes occur during 06:00-09:00 morning dispatch rush.
operational_relevance: Prevents dispatching all tankers to a single bottlenecked depot.

definition: Number of independent citizen complaints within a 500m radius and 4-hour window, filtered for spam and automated bot repeats.
data_source: MCGM 1916 Grievance Helpline / MyBMC App / WhatsApp Chatbot
known_limitations: Affluent wards have higher smartphone penetration and lodging rates than informal settlements.
double_counting_risk: High if duplicate complaints inflate volumetric demand.
operational_relevance: Validates unmonitored localized pipe burst or valve closure incidents.

definition: Hours elapsed since the initial registered complaint in an active cluster without municipal response or resolution.
data_source: BMC Citizen Charter SLA Tracking System
known_limitations: Citizen complaints occasionally remain open after private tankers or groundwater was secured.
operational_relevance: Enforces municipal Citizen Charter SLA escalation (escalates at 24h, 48h, 72h).

definition: Presence of citizen reports citing foul odor, turbidity, or sewage cross-contamination, corroborated by primary health post diarrhea clusters.
data_source: MCGM Epidemic Cell / Water Testing Laboratory Dadar
known_limitations: Laboratory bacteriological culture takes 24-48 hours; initial action relies on chlorine test kits and symptoms.
operational_relevance: Immediately blocks unsafe pipe source and routes emergency clean drinking water tankers.

factor_name: Distance to Public Standpost / Water Source
definition: Average physical walking distance from informal households to nearest functional municipal public standpost or community tap.
data_source: TISS (Tata Institute of Social Sciences) Mumbai Water Access Survey
known_limitations: Does not measure queuing time at standpost (which often exceeds 90 minutes).
operational_relevance: Monitors physical water-fetching hardship disproportionately borne by women and girls.

definition: Ratio of affluent residential per-capita supply (typically > 200 LPCD) to slum per-capita supply (< 50 LPCD) in the ward.
data_source: YUVA (Youth for Unity and Voluntary Action) Water Rights Audit / MCGM Human Development Report
known_limitations: Precise slum consumption is difficult to quantify due to unmetered shared taps.
operational_relevance: Audits compliance with equitable distribution principles under Constitution Article 21.

definition: TDS concentration of candidate water source: Acceptable limit < 500 mg/L; Permissible limit in absence of alternate source 2000 mg/L.
data_source: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) IS 10500:2012 Drinking Water Specification
known_limitations: TDS alone does not measure pathogen contamination (requires residual free chlorine test).
operational_relevance: Directs water to potable drinking vs non-potable tertiary reuse (toilet flushing, construction).

factor_name: Free Residual Chlorine at Tap Delivery
definition: Active residual chlorine level: Minimum 0.2 mg/L at consumer end; 0.5 mg/L during epidemic or monsoon flood alerts.
data_source: BIS IS 10500:2012 / CPHEEO Water Supply Manual
known_limitations: Excessive chlorination (> 1.0 mg/L) causes citizen taste complaints and rejection.
operational_relevance: Safety certification for tanker deliveries before opening valves to public storage tanks.
